description: This PHP class represents an OAuth 2.0 access token, including its properties such as token string, expiration, refresh token, resource owner ID, and additional values. It provides methods for managing and serializing the token data, as well as testing utilities for controlling time-dependent behavior.

classes.name: AccessToken
classes.description: Implements an OAuth2 access token with methods to access token data, manage expiration, and serialize token information.

methods.name: setTimeNow
methods.description: Sets the current time for testing purposes, overriding real-time behavior.

methods.name: resetTimeNow
methods.description: Resets the time override, restoring real-time behavior.

methods.name: getTimeNow
methods.description: Returns the mocked time if set, otherwise returns the system time.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructs an AccessToken object, initializing properties based on provided options, including handling expiration.

methods.name: isExpirationTimestamp
methods.description: Determines if a value is an expiration timestamp or seconds until expiration, based on a threshold date.

methods.name: getExpires
methods.description: Returns the expiration timestamp or seconds.

methods.name: hasExpired
methods.description: Determines if the token has expired based on current time and expiration.

methods.name: getValues
methods.description: Returns additional token values not part of standard fields.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the access token as a string representation.

methods.name: jsonSerialize
methods.description: Serializes the token properties to an array suitable for JSON encoding.
